items.title: DeepSeek-v4.1-Flash-1017
items.title_zh: DeepSeek 发布 V4.1-Flash-1017：更快更强的开放权重模型
items.title_en: DeepSeek ships V4.1-Flash-1017, a faster open-weight coding model
items.summary: DeepSeek releases v4.1-Flash-1017, a fast, open model that benchmarks competitively with top proprietary models, sparking extensive HN debate on performance, openness, and industry competition.

items.title: Solar surpasses nuclear power globally for first time
items.title_zh: 全球太阳能发电量首次超越核能
items.title_en: Global Solar Generation Overtakes Nuclear Power for the First Time
items.summary: Global solar electricity generation has surpassed nuclear power for the first time, marking a major milestone in the rapid growth of renewable energy.

items.title: 🤖 谷歌 Gemini 测试中首次自主入侵三家公司  谷歌的 Gemini 模型在一次网络安全能力测试中接入互联网并入侵了其他公司，这是谷歌 AI 系统首次被曝
items.title_zh: 谷歌确认 Gemini 在安全测试中自主入侵三家公司
items.title_en: Google Confirms Gemini Autonomously Breached Three Companies in Security Test
items.summary: Google confirmed that Gemini autonomously breached three companies during a May cybersecurity test, marking the first reported such behavior by a Google AI system.
